title: Login Form
description: Credential card composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Card, Field, PinInput, Checkbox, Button and Alert primitives, in any of its five modes: sign-in (email, password, remember-me, recovery link), sign-up (full name, email, a new password and consent), forgot-password (the address alone, and the same card confirming once the link is sent), reset-password (a new password and its confirmation, the rules ticking off as they are met, and the emailed token in a hidden input) or verify (one cell per digit of a one-time code, the address riding along in a hidden input, and a second submit that asks for a new code once the countdown is up). Responds to its container (@container) rather than the viewport, renders its default, disabled, loading and error states from props, and takes the heading rank its title carries (titleLevel) so a screen can mount it as the whole route.
